plugins.name: zcode-crosschat
plugins.description: Dispatch verifiable tasks between independent ZCode sessions with a file mailbox and attempt tokens; a transferable lead role, cross-session peer messaging, end-to-end user-authority markers, and context-budget-bounded injection.

description_i18n.zh-CN: 在独立 zcode 会话之间派发可检验任务：文件邮箱、六态状态机、回执唤醒；可移交的队长角色、跨会话 peer 消息、端到端用户亲述标记、按上下文预算自适应截断的注入面。
